intro: Marshal Dughan of Goldshire tasks scouts with investigating reports that the Fargodeep Mine has been overrun by kobolds. Located south of town between the Stonefield and Maclure farms, the mine's fall signals a growing pest problem throughout Elwynn Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems! I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.
Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me. The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you have to report, friend? Have you been to the Fargodeep Mine?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is bad news. What's next, dragons?!? We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine. Thanks for your efforts, friend. And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
